'''Noelle''' (Japanese: '''ノア''' ''Noa'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP138|Strategy Begins at Home!]]''. She is one of [[Johanna]]'s students as well as a friend of {{an|Dawn}}'s.

Prior to Dawn's return to [[Twinleaf Town]] with {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}}, Noelle had been staying at Dawn's home for the past week so she could train to become a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] under Johanna's guidance. Brock fell head over heels with her and proceeded to flirt with her throughout the day. He was eventually stopped not only by his {{TP|Brock|Croagunk}}, but by Noelle's overprotective {{p|Bellossom}} as well.

Noelle showed herself to be keen to learn. She was interested in Brock's recipes and thoroughly enjoyed Dawn and Johanna's {{wp|exhibition game|exhibition match}}.
